arc.energy_shape_notes: Staircase, not arches: quiet intro (mean -19.1dB) -> mid-level first half (-10.3dB) -> 28s dark valley at 3:35 -> louder, longer second half (-6.4dB, 3+ min) -> finale that opens on the loudest single window in the track (-2.4dB at 7:20, 89% of runtime), cuts to -21.9dB at 7:35, then closes loud-and-dark (-2.7dB at 8:00, -7.1dB final window, centroid 749Hz). Loudest 30s is 7:00-7:30 (-4.6dB); quietest 30s is the opening (-19.0dB). Dynamic range 28.1dB. The track peaks as it ends rather than before ending.

generator_hints.drums: four-on-the-floor (assumed, not measured - regular 143.6 grid only; no onset data in features)

harmony.home_scale: D natural minor (D E F G A Bb C); stable all 8:15 - 16/17 key windows D min (conf 0.44-0.74), single low-confidence Bb maj blip at 1:00-1:30 (0.534, the bVI read as tonic). Minor 3rd F beats F# in 40/50 chroma windows - settled minor, no third-toggle. After 4:03 harmony collapses to a near-pure D pedal (chroma D 0.96 at 4:00, 0.95 at 5:50, 1.00 at 7:20). Ends on D, in D minor.
signature_devices: Harmonic narrowing to a pedal: full natural-minor set early (D mean chroma 0.56-0.64, Bb and C present), strip to tonic alone in the second half (D 0.74 mean, up to 1.00). Progression as subtraction.
bVI tonicization (brief): Bb major read at 1:00-1:30, low confidence - the VI chord momentarily read as home, then D reasserts.
No raised leading tone, no V-i cadences, no secondary dominants - and unlike ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS, no refusal either: the tonic was never left, so the ending on D is redundant rather than denied.
Tempo gear-change as section boundary: step ~136 -> 143.6 BPM at ~3:00 (downbeat spacing 1.72s -> 1.67s), not a gradual accelerando. The step IS the transition.
Regular grid throughout: downbeat intervals 1.57-1.81s, beats tracked continuously 6.22-492.54s, no arrhythmic passage - the pulse never dissolves.
Cut-outs as punctuation: 17 windows below -14dB RMS scattered through every section, deepest late cut -21.9dB at 7:35 inside the finale, 15s after the loudest window.
First downbeat not detected until 6.22s - the opening is too quiet/sparse for the tracker (opening window -30.5dB).

tempo.feel: Regular grid with one gear-change: ~136 BPM for the first 3 minutes (per-minute estimator; downbeat spacing implies ~139), stepping to 143.6 BPM at ~3:00 and holding to the end. No accelerando, no slowdown, no grid dropout.

timbre.palette_notes: Bright surface, dark hinges. Centroid mostly 2000-3600Hz in the grooves (brightest 3760Hz at 4:45), section means: intro 1971Hz, groove 2607Hz, valley 1685Hz, pedal grind 2139Hz, finale 1714Hz. ZCR max 0.177 - no near-white noise bursts, unlike ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS' shrapnel (0.505). The two darkest windows mark structural turns: 726Hz (rolloff 1201Hz) at 3:35 valley entry, 749Hz (rolloff 990Hz, track minimum) at 8:10 final window. Limiter pinned at 0dBFS ~half the track (50/98 windows peak >= -0.1dB, 22 at exactly 0.0dB) as a ceiling.
